subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, FATHER is written as 'IFWMHW', and SISTER is written as 'VNVYHW'. How will 'UNCLE' be written in the same code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (3) and (5) are added alternately to the position values according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• FATHER is written as 'IFWMHW'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e595c68db51856b6696399ca7eacb05cdbc814eac49e7faf998dc3013221dc73.png] 

And,

 
• SISTER is written as 'VNVYHW'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db5d37c02b3bb6e149028782d225364b88736c0a4a5de933921234a7441ee8e4.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'UNCLE' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b07998a46df3ea0ff964bd1ca75975121039aa7992493102ffe1f1287fc0ccd.png] 

​Hence, "**XSFQH**" is the correct answer.

4d
